# proxmox_sdn_ipam (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox VE SDN IPAM through `/cluster/sdn/ipams`. Supported types are `pve` (built-in), `netbox` and `phpipam`. IPAMs stage like the other SDN objects and only take effect when `proxmox_sdn_apply` commits. A zone cannot change its IPAM once subnets exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

# IPAMs stay staged until proxmox_sdn_apply commits the SDN configuration.
# Provider credentials need SDN.Allocate on /sdn/ipams.

# The built-in PVE IPAM needs no connection data.
resource "proxmox_sdn_ipam" "local" {
  ipam = "pve"
  type = "pve"
}

# An external phpIPAM instance. `token` is stored in /etc/pve/sdn/ipams.cfg.
resource "proxmox_sdn_ipam" "phpipam" {
  ipam        = "ipam1"
  type        = "phpipam"
  url         = "https://phpipam.example.com/api"
  token       = var.phpipam_token
  section     = 3
  fingerprint = var.phpipam_fingerprint
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ipam` (String) IPAM identifier: starts with a letter, only letters and digits, at least 2 characters. Changes require replacement.
- `type` (String) IPAM type: `pve`, `netbox`, or `phpipam`. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the external IPAM TLS certificate.
- `section` (Number) phpIPAM section id. Required for `phpipam`.
- `token` (String) API token of the external IPAM. Required for `netbox` and `phpipam`. Proxmox stores it in `/etc/pve/sdn/ipams.cfg`, not in a private file.
- `url` (String) API URL of the external IPAM. Required for `netbox` and `phpipam`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) IPAM identifier (same as `ipam`).
- `pending` (Map of String) Properties Proxmox currently reports as staged but not committed, with `deleted` for removals.
- `state` (String) Proxmox staging state: `new` or `changed` while the IPAM is not committed yet.
